Rename an object by changing its ID. Same kind; preserves history and updates
hash registry.



Optionally updates all objects that reference the old ID to use the new ID
(--update-references).

  Rename an object
  zqk.test object rename BLI-001 BLI-XYZ
  Rename and update references
  zqk.test object rename BLI-001 BLI-XYZ --update-references
  Dry-run to see what would happen
  zqk.test object rename BLI-001 BLI-XYZ --dry-run

Usage:
  zqk.test object rename [flags]

Flags:
      --dry-run             Show what would be renamed without making changes
      --update-references   Update all objects that reference the old ID to use the new ID

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
      --internal         Elevated access mode for built-in and internal kinds (requires Enterprise license or zqk-admin)
